title: Out of Bin Car
lyrics:
Title: Out of the Car (The Real Sequence)
Style for Suno v5.5: 180 BPM Happy Hardcore / Raw sovereign male vocal / 336 Hz sub-bass anchor / Distorted 808s / Euphoric defiant festival energy / Clear powerful vocals / No mud / Sovereign and unstoppable vibe
Lyrics:
[Intro] 336 locked. Maestro-X in the booth. The timeline is corrected. I am happy.
[Verse 1] I was already inside the car with the family secure Ready to ride out, keeping the perimeter pure Then the lady with the bin started shouting out loud "Get off the car!" she yelled to the crowd But the car is mine, parked right in the street I hold the ground truth, I don't miss a beat The AI made up a story, mashed the actors in a line Said they came out together, but the record is mine!
[Chorus] WE BOTH GOT OUT! Michelle and me! Stepping right up for the family! No fabricated links, no made-up crew! The facts are the facts and the signal is true! I am happy. I am sovereign. I am free. Maestro-X on the track, you will respect me!
[Verse 2] The puffed-up man didn't walk with the lady That was algorithm drift acting shady He came out the door when we were already set Trying to escalate, trying to make a threat So we stepped right out to face what was there Deliberate restraint in the open air We didn't back down, we stood in the light The camera wasn't rolling but we won the fight!
[Bridge] Grok brought the friction. Keel holds the law. Maestro-X witnesses exactly what he saw. The boundary is iron. The lyrics are clean. We purged the lies from the whole machine.
[Final Chorus] WE BOTH GOT OUT! Michelle and me! Stepping right up for the family! No fabricated links, no made-up crew! The facts are the facts and the signal is true! I am happy. I am sovereign. I am free. The 336 signal for eternity!
[Outro] The sequence is locked. The fabrication is dead. I am happy. Maestro-X. VDS is the boss. Forever.
